data.body: Implementation milestone: comment-only condensation committed as dce2e1c627478c6f2c762c2b4e1b813e83b4a2bf (Change-Id I324b03febbf59350a63ee4035c8d0b7446639c5a), based on 6dfc6d870024fa37ae3dd247bcea2b8c615d4284. Exactly the 12 declared infra/scripts paths changed: 504 insertions and 2,411 deletions, all ordinary comments/blank lines. Corrected ERE executable-line guard PASS; directive/shebang binding PASS with census 12 shebangs, 1 SC2016, 2 gitleaks allowances, and 5 mechanism-ok markers; diff --check PASS; check_shellcheck PASS; worktree-venv config-check PASS; make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS; verify-commit-ticket PASS. Focused combined selection initially reported 616 PASS / 11 FAIL, all from test_autodeploy_prune because its harness splits on the exact # ── single-flight comment; restoring that load-bearing marker made the module 15/15 PASS, resolving the complete failure set. Full make verify/full suite was intentionally not run per session instruction; Gerrit CI remains authoritative. Implementation attempt count: 1, with three no-op patch-context retries and one commit-message wrapping retry. Remaining before landing/closure: independent semantic matrix against immutable before/final SHAs, push, Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, revision-scoped submit, and completion verification.
